versions.changelog:
- Added "homepage" and "metadata" fields to the skill manifest with relevant information.
- Specified platform compatibility (Darwin, Linux, Win32) and required environment variables in metadata.
- No changes to Python code or estimation logic.

**Major upgrade: Seamlessly automate BIM cost estimation using AI and an extensive construction cost database.**

- Adds end-to-end pipeline for automated cost estimation from BIM models using DDC CWICR (55,719 work items, 9 global regions).
- Enables AI classification of BIM elements and vector search for precise work item and rate matching.
- Supports multi-language cost data and pricing from major world cities.
- Provides detailed process breakdown and a clear Python implementation for real-world integration.
- Delivers estimates in hours with consistent methodology, reducing manual effort by up to 80%.

BIM Cost Estimation CWICR 1.0.0

- Initial release of automated BIM-to-cost estimation using the DDC CWICR database.
- Supports AI classification and vector search for accurate mapping of BIM elements to 55,719 work items with localized pricing in 9 languages.
- Pipeline includes quantity takeoff extraction, phase/trade mapping, multi-stage decomposition, and rapid cost reporting.
- Integration examples provided for OpenAI embeddings and Qdrant vector search.
- Outputs detailed estimates by element, trade, and phase, exportable to HTML and Excel.
